about_the_game:
Black Shadow is a first-person survival horror game.
Players take on the role of investigator Eric Stone, exploring a mysterious underground space permeated by dark matter in search of the truth and a way out.
In areas consumed by darkness, safety is never guaranteed.
The only things you can rely on are calm judgment, careful movement, and your instinct to escape.

Story

Across the Earth, a dark mist known as “Black Shadow” has appeared in multiple regions.
Probes indicate that it contains immense energy, yet no signs of hostility have been observed so far.

The Federal Research Institute dispatches investigator Eric Stone to one of the mist zones to conduct an investigation, hoping he can locate the teammates who have lost contact.

However, during his exploration, Eric encounters grave danger…

Core Gameplay

  • Stealth & Hiding: You cannot fight back against the unknown. Stay quiet, move cautiously, and find places to hide.

  • Survival Challenges: Limited light, oppressive environments, and constant danger will push your instincts to the limit.

Key Features

  • Immersive First-Person Horror: Experience the suffocating tension of darkness all around you.

  • Dynamic Fear Elements: Enemies and events are unpredictable, making every playthrough tense and unique.

How long can you endure the fear—before it consumes you completely?

short_description: Black Shadow is a first-person survival horror game built with Unreal Engine 5. Players take on the role of investigator Eric Stone, venturing deep into a core area filled with dark matter. In the dark underground, you must explore, move stealthily, evade unknown threats, and uncover the secrets.
